caption:
A stronger turn starts from the ground up. 💪

The landmine split stance rotation builds rotational strength with your feet planted: hips start it, ribs follow, arms just hold on.

✅ 3 x 8 each side, slow and controlled
✅ Eyes level, turn through the hips and mid-back
❌ Don't muscle it with your arms or twist from the low back

Comment "TURN" if this is going in your next workout.
